inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names a camera modality and keyword spotting, wake words or hotwords; the design compared is how the keyword is specified and which signal is used: a fixed wake word or keyword set, a text or phoneme query (zero-shot), an enrolled example query (few-shot), audio-visual fusion or visual-only input. Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text (reference list removed) names (upper bound); audio-only KWS and visual forced alignment without spotting are pattern hits only; versions count once.
